password_setting.label: API Key
password_setting.help: A standard OpenAI project or user API key (starts with sk-proj- or sk-), not an Admin key. Create one in the OpenAI Platform under API keys, with Model capabilities set to Write (or All permissions) so it can call /v1/chat/completions.

toggle.label: Use this API key to evaluate your LLM applications
toggle.help: Powers evaluators in Agent Observability with this key. Datadog checks that the key can call the OpenAI chat completions endpoint when you save.
